title: Two programs
text: โหนกระแส is the main show, cut from the raw broadcast. โหนหลังกระแส is a compilation of usually 4 already-edited โหนกระแส long videos, cut down again. Rules read from the dailies are about cutting a broadcast; rules from EP.162/167 (HKS-18 on) are about re-cutting finished cuts (the longer-pieces reason is an inference, not yet asked).
confirm: Is this a daily or a compilation, and which rule set does the cut follow?
